initial_conditions: rotating-globe truth, wind+mixed bias; same seed and path under all three fit candidates
runtime_quote: Unavailable until an approved pilot measures this implementation. Historical 7-12 s flights do not estimate the new envelope and dual-path cost.
acceptance_review: Scientific exclusions and every failure are retained.
All-contrast and pair-specific availability are separate.
Preserve forward-axis uncertainty, watchdog/control path, prior sensitivity, parameter-boundary diagnostics and actual domain observables.
A fitted crab or airspeed curve is model-dependent, not independent truth.
Bootstrap zero cannot establish error rates or promotion.

wind_tas.evidence: Conditional GNSS speed constraint with latent smooth TAS; no independent heading or airspeed observation
wind_tas.provenance: Provisional development assumptions; independent wind truth, calibration and hardware checks required

mount_yaw.basis: step and finite-duration linear yaw within each flagged segment and mount epoch
mount_yaw.agreement: both scientific paths eligible, identical endpoint decisions and shifts <= 1 sigma
mount_yaw.provenance: Provisional research assumptions; no independent measurement of mount yaw

ordinary_envelope.nuisance_state: dynamic intercept/drift grid or wind coefficient corners and individual drifts
ordinary_envelope.weighting: fixed isotropic design noise; no fitted gyro coefficients or residual weights
ordinary_envelope.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory

physical_envelope.nuisance_state: bounded north/east wind corners and drifts crossed with TAS levels/drifts
physical_envelope.weighting: fixed gyro noise 3 and 6 dph and conditional GNSS speed constraint; no gyro fit/residual weights
physical_envelope.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory

wind_tas_policy.evidence: Conditional GNSS speed constraint with latent smooth TAS; no independent heading or airspeed observation
wind_tas_policy.provenance: Provisional development assumptions; independent wind truth, calibration and hardware checks required

pending_controls: Matched true mount-slip controls and slowly varying/nonlinear wind/TAS departures remain necessary before protocol selection.
Other routes, original sparse-fix mode, schedule search and nonzero complete bootstrap need separately bounded stages.
Do not prune off-manifold envelope states or loosen the speed constraint based on favorable retained-model information.
